name: Amoud Foundation
mission: Founded in 1998, the Amoud Foundation impacts the local and global communities by helping people help themselves through sustainable humanitarian projects while maintaining trusting relationships. Amoud is an international humanitarian organization that today serves the people in the Horn of Africa. Amoud also does work on the home-front including helping with the 2006 Hurricane Relief and 2015 Garland Tornado recovery.

rich_narrative.summary: Amoud Foundation provides direct humanitarian support to communities in East Africa, focusing on orphan care and specialized education. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="5">total revenue of $11,142,566</cite>. Its primary efforts support <cite id="1">15 orphan centers and two schools for the deaf and blind</cite> in Somalia and Somaliland. The charity maintains <cite id="1">an 89% program ratio</cite> under evaluation benchmarks, ensuring that the vast majority of resources reach direct service operations. Additionally, <cite id="1">Charity Navigator evaluates its overall performance at 80/100</cite>, citing efficient fundraising alongside specific governance gaps. The organization confirms <cite id="2">its programs are zakat-eligible</cite>, serving needy families and vulnerable children through established local networks.
